definition: pleasure; enjoyment; delight.
example_en: The pleasure of the festival remained in everyone's mind.

definition: a chequered or colourful carpet.
example: ಆ ಕೊಠಡಿಯ ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಜಾಜೂಮು ಹಾಸಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A colourful carpet was spread on the floor of that room.

definition: imperfect, inadequate, faulty or absence of, nutrition; poor nourishment; malnutrition.
example_en: Children in poor villages are suffering from malnutrition.

definition: a shaping or giving a form to a plastic or molten material by pouring into a pattern, hollow form or a matrix.
example_en: The craftsman made the bell by casting molten metal.

definition: to provoke or enrage with a stinging, pungent remark.
example_en: My friend provoked me with a pungent remark and started a quarrel.

definition: a kind of children's game.
example_en: The girls were playing turige in the courtyard.

definition: an arrow.
example_en: The warrior aimed and threw the arrow.

definition: excessive weight.
example_en: The box could not be lifted because of its excessive weight.

definition: the condition of being puzzled, baffled or utterly confused.
example_en: His mind became utterly confused due to the difficult problem.

definition: anything like a round, long pillow or cushion used to lean on; a bolster.
example_en: He leaned against the bolster and read a book.

definition: a framework or structure of crossed wood or metal strips; lattice.
example_en: An iron lattice was fitted to the window.

definition: the need for, and the discomfort, pain caused by a need for, food; hunger.
example: ಶಾಲೆಯಿಂದ ಬಂದ ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ಬಹಳ ಹಸಿವು ಆಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The child who came from school was very hungry.

definition: a kind of dental disease.
example_en: He had suffered from that dental disease.

definition: a sacrificing of one's life (for a purpose, such as the welfare of another or others).
example_en: That soldier sacrificed his life for the country.

definition: the elected officer in the Indian governmental system, acting as the Chairman of the Rājya Sabhā and succeeding to the Presidency in the event of the President's death, incapacity or removal; Vice President (as in India or similar officer elsewhere).
example_en: The Vice President presided over the session of the Rajya Sabha.

definition: a particular kind of soil.
example: ಈ ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಪುಕ್ಕೊಳ್ಳಿ ಮಣ್ಣು ಬೆಳೆಗೆ ಸೂಕ್ತವಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: This particular kind of soil in the field is suitable for the crop.

definition: one more; one in addition.
example_en: He bought one more book.

definition: pain of the heart; chest-pain.
example_en: She suddenly experienced chest pain.

definition: havoc caused by flood.
example_en: Houses were washed away by the havoc caused by the flood in the village.

definition: an acquired, obsessive, bad habit.
example_en: He could not give up the obsessive bad habit of smoking cigarettes.

definition: that cannot be understood; not comprehensible; incomprehensible.
example_en: His writing was incomprehensible, and no one could understand it.

definition: the minister of a government who is in charge of maintenance of law and order, and domestic affairs of the state.
example_en: The home minister spoke about law and order.

definition: (gen.) a woman.
example_en: That woman was skilled in housework.

definition: the field growing lablab plants.
example_en: The farmer irrigated the field of lablab plants.

definition: proper estimation; recognition (of a person); appreciation.
example_en: His work did not get the proper recognition.

definition: the tree Fagus sylvatica of Fagaceae family; common beech.
example_en: They planted a common beech tree in the garden.

definition: insulting or coarse language; abuse.
example_en: In anger, he uttered abusive language.

definition: not dejected; not depressed.
example_en: Even when trouble came, he remained undejected.

definition: very cruel; brutal; inhuman; ruthless.
example: ಆ ದೊರೆ ಪ್ರಜೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ನಿದಾರುಣ ಶಿಕ್ಷೆ ವಿಧಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That ruler imposed a very cruel punishment on the subjects.

definition: a bunch of flowers, leaves or fruits.
example_en: She held a bunch of flowers in her hand.

definition: a great wonder.
example_en: All who saw that sight felt great wonder.

definition: flawlessness in craftsmanship, beauty, ingenuity, delicacy or elaborate execution; exquisiteness; fine excellence.
example_en: The exquisiteness of that sculpture amazed everyone.

definition: the act of soaking (something) in a liquid.
example_en: The soaking of the cloth took place in the coloured water.

definition: to become angry; to burst out in anger; to flare up.
example_en: He flared up in anger even at a small remark.

definition: to become thickened and be formed into clot or clots.
example_en: The blood clotted over the wound.

definition: the plant Capsicum minimum of Solanaceae family; birḍs pepper; needle-pepper.
example_en: Grandmother chopped the bird's pepper into small pieces.

definition: contrary to parliamentary law, practice or decorum; unparliamentary.
example_en: That member's conduct was unparliamentary.

definition: to stir, beat or shake (milk or cream) in a churn.
example_en: She churned the curd and took out the butter.

definition: a work or job done or to be done.
example_en: He finished the work he had taken up properly.

definition: (in comp.) gold.
example_en: He bought a gold bangle from the shop.

definition: transparent, colourless or slightly tinged quartz; a crystal.
example_en: That crystal was found in the hill cave.

definition: a specious argument for displaying ingenuity in reasoning or for deceiving someone; sophism.
example_en: His sophistical argument deceived everyone.

definition: an abnormality in digesting food; dyspepsia.
example_en: Because he ate too much, he got dyspepsia.

definition: spread through; pervaded all over.
example_en: The fragrance of the flowers was pervaded all over the garden.

definition: to receive initiation to a sacrifice or other religious ceremonies.
example_en: He received initiation from the guru.

definition: the condition of being young.
example_en: Many years have passed since her youth ended.

definition: a roll of palm leave inserted in to the hole as an ornament.
example_en: The palm-leaf-roll ear ornament shone in her ear.

definition: an organisation of persons having common interests, purposes, etc.; society; a league; an association.
example_en: The villagers formed an association.

definition: a bunch of hairs (braided or not).
example_en: She tied her hair into a bunch.

definition: the art of chiseling stone into three-dimensional representations, as statues, figures, forms, etc.; sculpture.
example: ಈ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ಕಲ್ಲೋಜತನವನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಬೆರಗಾದರು.
example_en: Everyone was amazed to see the stone sculpture of this temple.

definition: a cart with a box-type carriage having seats inside, covered on all sides and having a door on either side, drawn by a pair of bullocks.
example_en: They took the bride to the village wedding in a covered bullock-cart.

definition: a woman unfit for having sexual intercourse with.
example_en: The villagers called her a woman unfit for intercourse.

definition: to rouse; to incite; to urge; to stir up (to action).
example_en: The leader incited the soldiers to war.

definition: a contagious disease among cattle, sheep etc.
example_en: A contagious cattle disease spread and many cattle died.

definition: to make known a secret; to disclose; to divulge; to reveal.
example: ಅವಳು ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಗುಟ್ಟನ್ನು ಒಳಗುವೇಳಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ತಿಳಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: She disclosed the family secret and made it known to everyone.

definition: a man living in the frontier region.
example: ಪ್ರತ್ಯಂತವಾಸಿ ಆ ಮನುಷ್ಯನಿಗೆ ಎರಡು ಭಾಷೆಗಳೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿದ್ದವು.
example_en: That man living in the frontier region knew both languages.

definition: a drama enacted on a raised platform in the open theatre.
example_en: The villagers watched the open-platform drama with interest.

definition: the act of a person or animal that walks; walking; wandering; roaming.
example_en: The old man's walking has become slow now.

definition: an imaginary, flat circle delineating the directions.
example_en: The sailor looked at the compass-circle and identified the direction.

definition: an ornament for the ankles; an anklet.
example_en: They put a gold anklet on the bride.

definition: above suspicion; trustworthy.
example_en: The king agreed that that minister was above suspicion.

definition: to spin (something or a person) or cause to rotate around an axis; to revolve.
example_en: The boy spun the wheel with his hand.

definition: a room, building etc. in which the office of guards, policemen is housed.
example_en: The policemen were on duty at that town's guard post.

definition: a hole to peep through; a peep-hole.
example_en: She looked outside through the peep-hole in the door.

definition: a joining, uniting or being joined, united; union.
example: ಎರಡು ಪಕ್ಷಗಳ ಸನ್ನಿಪಾತದಿಂದ ಹೊಸ ಒಕ್ಕೂಟ ರೂಪುಗೊಂಡಿತು.
example_en: A new union was formed from the joining of the two parties.

definition: the tree Prunus armeniaca (= Armeniaca vulgaris of Rosaceae family.
example_en: The fruit of the apricot tree is sweet.

definition: in the very next moment.
example_en: In the very next moment he changed his mind.

definition: the extent, dimensions, capacity, etc. of anything, esp. as determined by a standard.
example_en: The capacity of this pot is ten liters.

definition: high or relatively high temperature; hotness.
example_en: High fever came upon him and his body was burning.

definition: the quality of being brave, fearless; the inclination towards adventures; dauntlessness.
example_en: Even facing danger, his fearlessness did not diminish.

definition: to spread or daub (an oily, greasy, viscous or wet substance) on or over something; to smear; to anoint.
example_en: She smeared oil on the wound.

definition: (hist.) a kind of cartridge used in firing from fire-arms.
example: ಆ ಸೈನಿಕರು ಸುಲ್ತಾನಿತೋಟ ಬಳಸಿ ಗುಂಡು ಹಾರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: Those soldiers fired using that kind of cartridge.

definition: to move upward off the ground or other surface by sudden muscular effort in the legs; to jump up.
example_en: The boy jumped up with joy.

definition: the thick, slimy secretion of the mucous membranes in the nose, that moistens and protects them; mucus of the nose.
example_en: Mucus was flowing from the crying child's nose.

definition: a boy or man as related to either or both patents; a son.
example_en: His son is working as a doctor.

definition: a natural mixture of earth, rock powder, with gold particles (from which gold is extracted).
example_en: The miners separated the gold from the gold-bearing earth.

definition: a city or town with a harbor where ships can load and unload cargo; a port.
example_en: Ships stood in a row at that port.

definition: of the nature of cheating; tending to deceive (another or others).
example: ಅವನ ಟಕ್ಕ ಮಾತುಗಳಿಂದ ಯಾರೂ ಮೋಸ ಹೋಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Nobody was fooled by his deceitful words.

definition: a pair of scissors used to shear wool.
example_en: The shepherd sheared the sheep's wool with the shearing scissors.

definition: to become numbed physically; to be benumbed.
example: ಬೆಂಚಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತಿದ್ದ ಕಾರಣ ಅವನ ಕಾಲಿಗೆ ಜೋಮುಹಿಡಿಯಿತು.
example_en: His leg went numb because he had sat on the bench.

definition: a work which one is regularly engaged in; profession; occupation.
example_en: His profession was trade.

definition: a man who values peaceful mind and state most.
example_en: He, a man who valued a peaceful mind, always lived in peace.

definition: the life of human beings.
example_en: Saints say that human life is transient.

definition: a maker of cakes; a baker; a confectioner.
example: ಆ ಆಪೂಪಿಕನು ರುಚಿಯಾದ ಸಿಹಿ ತಿಂಡಿಗಳನ್ನು ತಯಾರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That confectioner makes tasty sweet snacks.

definition: any of the several incarnations of the Supreme Being in which the Supreme qualities or characteristics are completely manifested.
example_en: Devotees worship Rama as a complete incarnation of the Supreme Being.

definition: a loop formed in a rope, cord, etc. by means of a slipknot so that the loop tightens as the rope is pulled; a noose.
example_en: He made a noose at the end of the rope.

definition: that which is not polluted, adulterated.
example_en: The water of that reservoir appeared unpolluted.

definition: the untrimmed beard of a man.
example_en: That ascetic wandered about with an untrimmed beard.

definition: to serve food to.
example_en: The servant served food to the guests.

definition: a decayed or infected tooth; a carious tooth.
example_en: He went to the dentist to get the carious tooth extracted.

definition: a festival of lights, observed during Kārtīka, the eighth month in Hindu lunar calendar (approx. coinciding with November); dīpāvali.
example_en: On the day of the festival of lights, everyone lit lamps.

definition: (a large number of persons) to stand in a line; to form a queue.
example_en: The students formed a queue in front of the examination room.

definition: a making of harsh sounds in breathing, while asleep as caused by vibration of the soft palate usu. with the mouth open; the act or sound of snoring.
example: ಆಯಾಸದಿಂದ ಮಲಗಿದ ಆತ ಜೋರಾಗಿ ಗುಱುಕು ಹೊಡೆದ.
example_en: Exhausted, he slept and snored loudly.

definition: a red-coloured wild dog (Cuon alpinus), which hunts in packs, attacking even large game; a dhole.
example_en: A pack of dholes chased a deer in the forest.

definition: the speech spoken with an intention to bringing dishonour or disgrace to another.
example_en: Do not speak words meant to disgrace others, for it hurts the heart.

definition: to undertake a journey; to go on a journey.
example_en: The pilgrims undertook a journey to Kashi.

definition: a variety of apes that are red in colour.
example: ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಕೆಂಗೋಡಗ ಮರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A red-coloured ape was sitting on the tree in the forest.

definition: anything one has to do; a task; a work; a job.
example_en: Who will do this task?

definition: a sub-caste of mādigas.
example: ಆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ದಕ್ಕಲು ಜನರು ಬಹಳಷ್ಟು ಇದ್ದಾರೆ.
example_en: There are many people of the Dakkalu sub-caste in that village.

definition: a hurrying; hurry.
example_en: He left the house in a great hurry.

definition: a compelling or being compelled; coercion; constraint; compulsion.
example_en: That agreement had come about through coercion.

definition: to slide down; to fall down.
example: ಮೆಟ್ಟಿಲ ಮೇಲಿಂದ ಅವನ ಕಾಲು ಪಯ್ಸರವೋಗಿ ಬಿತ್ತು.
example_en: His foot slid down from the step and he fell.

definition: a shaven head.
example_en: On the day of the funeral rite, he got his head shaven.

definition: any of the three days in a lunar fortnight that are considered as complete days - they are fifth, tenth days and the full moonday.
example_en: The devotees observed a vow on the complete day.

definition: a foot not wearing footwear; a bare-foot.
example_en: He set out from home bare-foot.

definition: a feeling of high regard, honour or esteem.
example_en: He has good esteem in society.

definition: a swollen, inflamed area in body tissues, in which pus is gathered.
example: ಅವನ ಕಾಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪುಂಡು ಬೆಳೆದು ಕೀವು ತುಂಬಿತು.
example_en: A sore grew on his leg and filled with pus.

definition: a flowering plant.
example: ಅವಳು ಕಿಟಕಿಯ ಬಳಿ ಒಂದು ಪೂಗಿಡು ನೆಟ್ಟಳು.
example_en: She planted a flowering plant near the window.

definition: an attic immediately below the roof of a house; a loft inside a house.
example_en: They stored the grains in the attic inside the house.

definition: any of various poisonous snakes.
example_en: A poisonous snake was hiding in the village bush.

definition: (law.) that gives cause for an action or lawsuit; actionable.
example_en: That breach of contract was an actionable case.

definition: a cylinder of wood or metal, over which heavy logs of wood are rolled for easier movement; a roller.
example_en: They rolled the logs of wood over the roller.

definition: a crisp dish made by stuffing with sweet powder or mixture, fried in oil or ghee.
example_en: On the festival day, they fried hurigadubu.

definition: a fighting hurling stones.
example: ಊರ ಹೊರಗೆ ಕಲ್ಲಾಕಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆದು ಇಬ್ಬರೂ ಗಾಯಗೊಂಡರು.
example_en: A stone-hurling fight took place outside the town and both were injured.

definition: a cow-herd woman.
example_en: The cow-herd woman used to milk the cows in the morning.

definition: a big crowd of people.
example_en: On the fair day a big crowd of people gathered on the street.

definition: the state or fact of being a bankrupt; bankruptcy; insolvency.
example_en: That company declared bankruptcy.

definition: a most talented archer.
example_en: People praised Arjuna as a most talented archer.

definition: in, to or at some place not known or specified.
example_en: He wandered off to some unspecified place and got lost.

definition: a man who pretends miserable plight; a pretender.
example_en: Nobody believed the words of the pretender.

definition: a messenger boy.
example_en: The messenger boy carried the message from house to house.

definition: to bring together; to cause to assemble; to collect; to congregate.
example_en: They gathered the villagers together and held a meeting.

definition: to deride; to scoff at derisively; to mock.
example_en: He mocked the poor.

definition: the hand, that has five terminal points.
example_en: Pancashaka means the hand with its five fingers.

definition: to keep, put or store at a place.
example_en: He stored the grain in the granary.

definition: excessive grief; acute sorrow.
example_en: Her son's death caused her acute sorrow.

definition: any intoxicating drink.
example_en: The intoxicating drink called halipriye was very strong.

definition: a drizzling rain.
example_en: A drizzling rain was falling in the morning.

definition: the medium sized, deciduous tree Feronia limonia ( = F. elephantum) of Rutaceae family.
example_en: The baḷūla tree in the backyard has borne fruits.

definition: unambiguously; directly; in a straightforward, frank manner.
example_en: He stated his opinion frankly and directly.

definition: to make longer; to stretch; to elongate.
example_en: The editor suggested making the article longer still.

definition: a cloud.
example_en: A cloud covered the hill and it became cool.

definition: a harmless, moderate-sized, tropical lizard, Iguana tuberculata, of Iguanidae family, that feeds on insects or vegetation and have a row of spines from neck to tail, which is known for its grip and is used in scaling forts; the common iguana.
example: ಉಡು ಮರದ ಕೊಂಬೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಸೊಳ್ಳೆಗಳನ್ನು ತಿನ್ನುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The iguana sat on the tree branch and ate mosquitoes.

definition: softly; smoothly; slowly.
example_en: He opened the door softly.

definition: a man who is prospering.
example: ಹೋತಕರಿಯಾದ ಅವನು ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಮನೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: Having become a prospering man, he built a big house in the town.

definition: to communicate through spoken or written words.
example_en: The minister communicated the new scheme to the people.

definition: a fight between two bulls (conducted as a sport); a bull-fight.
example_en: The bull-fight at the village fair attracted people.

definition: to bring together; to cause to assemble; to collect; to congregate.
example: ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರನ್ನು ಒಕ್ಕೈಸಿ ಊರಿಗೆ ಹೋದನು.
example_en: He collected his friends together and went to the town.

definition: the erect, annual leguminous plant Cyamopsis tetrangonoloba of Papilionaceae family, widely grown for its bean; guar plant.
example_en: The farmers grew the guar crop in the field.

definition: a kitchen garden at the backyard of a house.
example_en: Mother has grown vegetable plants in the kitchen garden.

definition: boiled rice.
example_en: She served hot boiled rice onto the plate.

definition: a person who contracts to supply certain materials or do certain work for a stipulated sum; a contractor.
example_en: That contractor took up the road work.

definition: the colour of pure snow; the white colour.
example_en: The whiteness of that cloth was pleasing to the eye.

definition: a place where fish, etc. are caught; fishing ground; fishery.
example: ನದಿಯ ಈ ಭಾಗ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಮೀನಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ಎಂದು ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧವಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: This part of the river is famous as a good fishing ground.

definition: the chief officer of a village.
example_en: The village chief conducted the village assembly.

definition: a farewell song.
example_en: Friends sang a farewell song at the time of departure.

definition: a man who makes, repairs or alters clothes; a tailor.
example_en: The tailor mended my trousers and gave them back.

definition: (eczema) to affect a part of the body.
example_en: Eczema has affected his hand.

definition: an endowment gifted to a person for the service.
example_en: The king gave him an endowment for his service.

definition: (a large number of persons) to stand in a line; to form a queue.
example_en: The children stood forming a queue in front of the class.

definition: an ugly form or shape.
example: ಆ ಪ್ರತಿಮೆಯ ಅಬಾಡ ನೋಡಲು ಭಯ ಹುಟ್ಟಿಸುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The ugly form of that statue was frightening to look at.

definition: the chief of a religious institution.
example_en: That head of the monastery gave religious teachings to his disciples.

definition: waste matter excreted by mouse, dog, bird etc. from the bowels.
example_en: The dog's excreta lay in the yard.

definition: the movement of blood out of and back to the heart through the arteries and veins; blood circulation.
example_en: The heart controls the circulation of blood.

definition: to pile or stack one above the other.
example_en: The laborers stacked the sacks one above the other.

definition: to be or become corresponding, matching or homogenous.
example_en: The new rule became corresponding to the old one.

definition: one who writes; a writer (esp. a professional one).
example_en: The scribe wrote down the palace accounts.

definition: a large container made of interwoven cane, rushes, strips of wood, etc. used for storing grains; a basket-granary.
example_en: A lot of paddy was stored in the basket-granary in the shed.

definition: a particular manner of playing musical instruments.
example_en: The teacher taught the students a new manner of playing the instrument.

definition: in a crooked manner; crookedly.
example_en: The tree branch bent crookedly in the storm.

definition: to tie in or with a knot.
example: ಅವಳು ಸೀರೆಯ ಸೆರಗಿಗೆ ಗಿಂಚುಹಾಕಿ ಹಣ ಕಟ್ಟಿಕೊಂಡಳು.
example_en: She tied the money into a knot at the end of her sari.

definition: a highway; a main road.
example_en: A new highway has been built on the outskirts of the city.

definition: a long but relatively narrow and deep hollow or valley formed by or as by the action of a stream; a ravine.
example: ಆ ದರಿಯ ಆಳ ನೋಡಲು ಭಯ ಹುಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: Seeing the depth of that ravine was frightening.

definition: a man who is indifferent; an apathetic man.
example: ಆ ಸನ್ಯಾಸಿಯು ಲೌಕಿಕ ಸುಖಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವಿರಕ್ತನಾಗಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That ascetic was indifferent towards worldly pleasures.

definition: the tree Terminalia bellirica (=T. bellerica) of Combretaceae family.
example: ಅರಣ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಕಳಿಂದ ಮರ ಬೆಳೆದಿದೆ.
example_en: A large Terminalia bellirica tree has grown in the forest.

definition: to find out how much of a certain substance is contained in a known volume of a solution by measuring volumetrically how much of a standard solution is required to produce a given reaction; to titrate.
example_en: The chemist titrated the concentration of the solution.

definition: a blind man.
example_en: The blind man was begging for alms in the town.

definition: a kind of medical treatment that cures bodily and mental diseases, and brings back vigour and energy to the patient.
example_en: The doctors gave him a revitalizing treatment.

definition: a man who makes, repairs or alters clothes; a tailor.
example_en: The tailor is stitching new clothes.

definition: the part of a stamen that produces and releases the pollen; an anther.
example_en: The bee collected pollen from the flower's anther.

definition: tendency or inclination to talk a great deal; talkativeness.
example_en: Everyone was tired of his talkativeness.

definition: a net or screen for keeping out mosquitoes; a mosquito net.
example: ಕಿಟಕಿಗೆ ನುಸಿಬಲೆ ಹಾಕಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಸೊಳ್ಳೆ ಒಳಗೆ ಬರುತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: After putting a mosquito net on the window, mosquitoes do not come inside.

definition: the plant Fumaria indica ( = F. parviflora) of Fumariaceae family.
example_en: They use the madhure plant for medicine.

definition: a great number of people gathered together; crowd; throng.
example_en: The crowd of people was packed at the fair.

definition: a bird's bill; the beak.
example_en: The bird pecked the grain with its beak.

definition: (pl.) the two segments or pieces of a fruit, vegetable, etc.
example_en: He separated the two segments of the mango fruit.

definition: resoluteness of the mind; determination; resolution.
example: ಗುರಿ ಮುಟ್ಟಲು ಅವನಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಬಲ ಇಚ್ಛಾಶಕ್ತಿ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: He had strong willpower to reach his goal.

definition: to hide or cover from sight or observation.
example_en: She hid her face with the end of her sari.

definition: a rift, cleft, crack, etc. to come to surface or to be seen prominently.
example_en: The crack in the wall suddenly came to the surface.

definition: the body of an ox.
example_en: That ox's body was sturdy.

definition: a renowned wrestler.
example: ಆ ಪೈಲ್ವಾನ ಇಡೀ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಜಗಜಟ್ಟಿ ಎಂದು ಹೆಸರಾಗಿದ್ದ.
example_en: That wrestler was renowned throughout the town as a great wrestler.

definition: of, at, near or along a coast; coastal.
example_en: Fishing is abundant in the coastal region.

definition: a person who works or employed to do some works; a worker.
example: ಆ ಫ್ಯಾಕ್ಟರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಲವು ಗೆಯ್ಯಾಳುಗಳು ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Many workers work in that factory.

definition: the state or fact of being.
example: ಅವನ ಇಪ್ಪೆಗೆ ಯಾವುದೇ ಕಾರಣ ಬೇಕಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ಅವನು ಹೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: He said that his state of being needs no reason.

definition: to compete, vie with.
example_en: The two competitors vied with each other for the prize.

definition: the quality of being fleshy, plump.
example: ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಊಟ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದರಿಂದ ಅವನ ಮೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗಡವತನ ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Because he had eaten well, plumpness showed in his body.

definition: a length of a hollow pipe of glass, rubber or metal, for conveying fluids; a tube.
example_en: Water flowed through the rubber tube.

definition: to turn both the ends of a thin, lengthy object in different directions; to twist.
example: ಅವನು ತಂತಿಯ ಎರಡು ತುದಿಗಳನ್ನು ಮುರಿಪು ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He twisted both ends of the wire.

definition: a fixed compensation periodically paid to a person for regular work or services; salary.
example_en: He receives his salary at the end of the month.

definition: a medicinal plant.
example: ಉಪ್ಪಾರಿತ ಗಿಡವನ್ನು ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ವೈದ್ಯರು ಔಷಧಿಗೆ ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The village physicians use the uppārita plant for medicine.

definition: a young boy; an infant.
example_en: That young boy was playing in the courtyard.

definition: a pillar erected as a monument of victory.
example_en: That victory pillar is centuries old.

definition: inspiration received from the God or deep meditation.
example_en: Divine inspiration is the root cause of his poems.

definition: one who delights, causes delight.
example_en: He is a delight-giver, he brings happiness to everyone.

definition: to make a buzzing sound (in the ear).
example: ಜೊತೆಗಾರನ ರಹಸ್ಯ ಕೇಳಿ ನನ್ನ ಕಿವಿ ಗುದುಗುದಿಸಿತು.
example_en: When I heard my companion's secret, my ear began to buzz.

definition: a climbing up, as mounting on the back of a horse, elephant etc.
example_en: The soldiers' mounting of horses became easy through training.

definition: to come together in a large group; to crowd; to throng; to assemble; to become dense.
example_en: People had crowded together for the fair.

definition: of this kind, sort.
example_en: He wanted that kind of work.

definition: to be counted.
example_en: Every vote was counted in the election.

definition: that cannot become weak, thin or emaciated.
example_en: That yogi's strength was unfailing and never weakened.

definition: steam coming out of water while being heated.
example_en: Steam was rising from the boiling water.

definition: to arrange or group in classes according to some system or principle; to classify.
example_en: They classified the books in the library according to subject.

definition: (pl.) three parallel lines or bans (as made with three fingers in applying the sacred ash on the body.
example_en: The three parallel lines of sacred ash were clearly visible on his forehead.

definition: one who worships a deity in a temple; a priest.
example: ಆ ಅಚ್ಚಿಗ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ದೇವರಿಗೆ ಪೂಜೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That priest performs worship of the deity every morning.

definition: a loud cry; a shout.
example_en: A loud shout of people was heard in the street.

definition: (masc.) a god, a deity.
example: ಅಚ್ಚರರು ಸ್ವರ್ಗದಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ ಎಂದು ಪುರಾಣಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The puranas say that the gods live in heaven.

definition: the basic monetary unit of the U.S. (equal to 100 cents), Australia, Canada, Barbados, etc.; symbol $; dollar.
example_en: He exchanged dollars for the trip.

definition: to reach (something) by stretching one's hand.
example_en: He reached the tall branch by stretching his hand.

definition: to bring under one's control or jurisdiction.
example_en: The king brought the neighbouring kingdom under his control.

definition: a passage selected or quoted from a book, article, etc.; an extract; an excerpt; a quotation.
example_en: He selected a quotation from that book.

definition: to make new or as if new again; to renew.
example_en: He renovated the old house beautifully.

definition: not sure of; not definite; uncertain.
example: ಮಳೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹವಾಮಾನ ಇಲಾಖೆಯ ಮಾತು ಮೋಘಮ ಆಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The weather department's word about the rain was uncertain.

definition: to know (something) by a sign, mark or token.
example_en: He identified the thief by the mark of the footprint.

definition: an acute, highly contagious, febrile disease, caused by the variola virus, and characterised by vomiting, prolonged fever, a pustular eruption that often leaves permanent pits or scars; small-pox.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಯ್ಲಿ ರೋಗ ಬಹಳ ಜನರನ್ನು ಬಲಿ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In olden times, small-pox used to claim many lives.

definition: that which supports; on which anything rests; a support.
example: ಈ ಕಂಬವು ಇಡೀ ಮೇಲ್ಚಾವಣಿಗೆ ಆಸರು ಆಗಿದೆ.
example_en: This pillar is a support for the entire roof.

definition: a school, training institute that prepares or intendeds to prepare, one for an occupation or in a trade; vocational school.
example: ಈ ಕಸಬುಶಾಲೆ ಬಡಗಿ ಕೆಲಸದಲ್ಲಿ ತರಬೇತಿ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: This vocational school provides training in carpentry work.

definition: he who teaches, esp. whose occupation is to instruct; a teacher; a professional instructor.
example_en: That teacher (ōjha) teaches mathematics to the children.

definition: a borer beetle, an insect belonging to Lepidoptera order.
example_en: The borer beetle had bored a hole in the mango tree.

definition: an involuntary opening of the mouth and taking a deep breath as from weariness, boredom, etc.; a yawn and the act of yawning.
example_en: A yawn came to him from weariness.

definition: meanness; baseness.
example_en: Everyone in the village was fed up with his meanness.

definition: a favourable estimation in which a person is held; good reputation.
example_en: He earned a good reputation through honest work.

definition: to run away; to take to heels.
example_en: Seeing the police, the thief took to his heels.

definition: a pair of (usu. parallel) pillars.
example_en: A pair of pillars was erected in front of the temple.

definition: well-being, happiness; health and prosperity (of a person or community etc.); welfare.
example_en: Everyone prayed for the well-being of this village.

definition: a street where commercial shops are located; a bazaar.
example: ಅವನು ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಪೇಟೆಗೆ ಹೋಗಿ ತರಕಾರಿ ತಂದನು.
example_en: He went to the bazaar in the morning and brought vegetables.

definition: water.
example_en: The boat was floating in the middle of the water.

definition: without any order or system or discipline; haphazardly.
example: ಅವನು ಪುಸ್ತಕಗಳನ್ನು ಅಡ್ಡಂತಿಡ್ಡ ಮೇಜಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿಸಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He threw the books haphazardly onto the table.

definition: a depressed, dejected man.
example_en: He sat there dejected because of the defeat.

definition: to reduce to nothing; to annihilate.
example_en: The fire annihilated all the trees in the forest.

definition: a fat, corpulent man.
example_en: That fat, corpulent man got tired climbing the stairs.

definition: a small, usu. hard, tumorous growth on the skin, caused by a virus; a wart.
example_en: A wart appeared on her leg.

definition: a man who sells loads (of hay) carrying on the back of an ox.
example: ಕವಾಡಿಗನು ಎತ್ತಿನ ಬೆನ್ನಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಹೊರೆ ಹಾಕಿ ಸಂತೆಗೆ ಹೋದನು.
example_en: The hay-seller loaded the bundle on the ox's back and went to the market.

definition: any of a family (Sciuridae) of small rodents living in trees, on the ground or in burrows and usu. having a long bushy tail; a squirrel.
example: ಕುಂಡೆಚ್ಚ ಮರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಕಾಯಿ ತಿನ್ನುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The squirrel sat on the tree and ate a nut.

definition: the act of observing or adhering to (as rules, customs, etc.).
example_en: Observing the law is the duty of every citizen.

definition: (in comp.) small; little.
example_en: He touched me with his little finger.

definition: the condition, fact or quality of existing or having one's specific nature only by relation to something else; relativity.
example_en: This theory is based on relativity.

definition: a feeling of discontent and ill will because of another's advantages, possessions, etc.; resentful dislike of another who has something that one desires; envy; jealousy.
example: ಅವನ ಸಂಪತ್ತನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ನನ್ನಲ್ಲಿ ಅೞ್ಕಜ ಹುಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: Seeing his wealth, envy arose in me.

definition: the property of a moreadequate quantity or supply; abundance; copiousness.
example_en: This year the abundance of the crop was good.

definition: the sensation of itching.
example_en: An itching sensation started where the mosquito bit.

definition: the quality or condition of being translucent; translucence.
example_en: That glass has some translucence.

definition: to be tolerant of another's behaviour; to be permissive.
example_en: Good teachers are tolerant of their students' mistakes.

definition: to melt gold (or other metal) and purify.
example_en: The goldsmith melted the silver and purified it.

definition: the act of donating, gifting.
example_en: The rich man performed the act of donating food to the poor.

definition: a person who manages the affairs of a government department, private firm, etc.; an administrator.
example: ಆ ಕಾರಭಾರಿ ಕಂಪನಿಯ ಎಲ್ಲ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: That administrator manages all the affairs of the company.

definition: a kind of contagious, small pox characterised by red pustular eruptions on the skin.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಗೋಣಿತಟ್ಟು ಹರಡಿ ಅನೇಕರು ಸತ್ತರು.
example_en: Smallpox spread in that town and many people died.

definition: a guarding of another under one's personal supervision.
example: ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ತಂಗಿಯ ಕೆಯ್ಗಾವಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಆಕೆಯನ್ನು ಕಾಪಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He protected his younger sister under his personal supervision.

definition: a place, enclosed or not, adjacent to a building; a yard.
example_en: The children were playing in the yard of the house.

definition: a small chisel used in making a hole or recess cut in a piece of wood to receive the tenon of another piece of wood; a mortise-chisel.
example_en: In woodwork, the mortise chisel is used to cut a hole.

definition: absence of arrogance, conceit; humility.
example_en: His humility showed his greatness.

definition: a round piece of stone, as a pebble.
example_en: A round pebble was found on the river bank.

definition: leaves of Nicotiana tabacum (Solanaceae family).
example_en: The farmers dried the tobacco leaves and sent them to the market.

definition: (pl.) how many people (implying all, are large number of people).
example_en: There was no counting how many people had gathered for the fair.

definition: a charming, fascinating woman.
example_en: The people of the village admired that charming woman.

definition: a red coloured squirrel.
example_en: A red coloured squirrel was playing near the window.

definition: to make (something) proper or befitting.
example_en: The teacher made his conduct proper and befitting.

definition: water or other liquid taken into mouth (for riinsing).
example_en: He took a mouthful of water and rinsed his mouth.

definition: the plant Curcuma amada of Zingiberaceae family.
example_en: They made chutney using mango-ginger in the cooking.

definition: a wealthy man.
example_en: That wealthy man was the owner of a big shop.

definition: she who has bathed.
example_en: She who had bathed set out to the temple for worship.

definition: not freed; confined by or as by binding; tied; bound.
example_en: The unfreed bird got caught in the net.

definition: loveliness; comeliness; beauty.
example_en: The loveliness of her face attracted everyone.

definition: a string of gold or silver for wearing round the neck; a necklace.
example_en: She had carefully kept that necklace in the box.

definition: the condition of somewhat dark; lack of sufficient light; dimness.
example_en: Dimness had spread in the forest and nothing was visible.

definition: relating to meaning or sense.
example_en: This word is subject to analysis relating to meaning.

definition: to be surprised greatly.
example_en: Hearing the result, he was greatly surprised.

definition: to rule as a sovereign; to reign.
example_en: That king reigned over his subjects with justice.

definition: (a term applied indistinctively to) Greece, any other European or Muslim country.
example_en: That merchant had come from a Greek or Muslim country.

definition: two pouches connected at one side of their mouth so that it can be put on the back of an animal or on one's shoulder and in both things can be filled.
example: ಕುರುಬ ತನ್ನ ಹಸಿಬೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ರೊಟ್ಟಿ ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡು ಬೆಟ್ಟ ಹತ್ತಿದನು.
example_en: The shepherd climbed the hill carrying bread in his pouch.

definition: arbitration by settling the differences by concession from both the parties involved, the process of which need not be bound by or as per the rules.
example_en: The elders settled the dispute through mutual concession arbitration.

definition: an intelligent woman.
example: ಆಕೆ ಬಹಳ ಚಿತ್ತಿನಿ, ಎಲ್ಲ ವಿಷಯದಲ್ಲೂ ಜಾಣೆ.
example_en: She is a very intelligent woman, clever in every matter.

definition: a long wooden handle of an axe; a helve.
example_en: The handle of the axe had broken.

definition: some quantity, number, measure.
example_en: Some quantity of rice remained in the sack.

definition: energetic activity; stir; bustle; ferment.
example_en: The bustle in the wedding house had reached the sky.

definition: a village under the direct administrative control of a government.
example_en: Government officials conducted an inspection in the village under direct government control.

definition: an old woman.
example_en: That old woman was sitting in front of the house.

definition: a boy.
example_en: The boy was playing ball in the playground.

definition: (dial.) a road that has ascending slope.
example_en: This uphill road was very difficult to climb.

definition: a soldier who fights with a sharp weapon, as a sword, spear, etc.
example: ಆ ಮೊನೆಗಾರ ಖಡ್ಗ ಹಿಡಿದು ಶತ್ರುಗಳನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That soldier faced the enemies holding a sword.

definition: a man who has become famous.
example_en: Through his achievement, he became a famous man.

definition: the cardinal number forty; 40.
example_en: There were forty eggs in the shop.

definition: official records collectively.
example_en: Without records the work cannot proceed.

definition: the chief officer of a village.
example_en: The village chief settled the village's boundary dispute.

definition: to pose an obstacle or obstacles to retard another progress; to obstruct; to hinder.
example_en: The rain obstructed our journey.

definition: the citrus tree Citrus auruntium (var. dimorphorapa) of Rutaceae family.
example: ಅಂಗಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆರುಳಿ ಮರ ನಿಂಬೆಯಂತಹ ಹಣ್ಣುಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The citrus tree in the yard had borne lemon-like fruits.

definition: that which functions without having or being connected through wire or wires, as wireless telegraphy, radio, etc.
example_en: Today's phones use wireless technology.

definition: a kind of stringed musical instrument.
example_en: He sang while plucking the stringed instrument.

definition: accomplishment; fulfilment.
example_en: Good fulfilment was seen in his work.

definition: a number of people or things arranged so as to form a line; a row.
example_en: The children stood in a row and prayed.

definition: pure gold (that is unmixed with other substances as copper.
example_en: Her bangles were made of pure gold.

definition: to be bound, fastened; to be tied to or with.
example_en: The knot was bound tightly with a rope.

definition: to talk much, incessantly, and foolishly; to chatter; to prate.
example_en: That boy kept chattering foolishly in the middle of the gathering.

definition: a kind of ear-ring.
example_en: A beautiful ear-ring shone in her ear.

definition: an agricultural implement to remove the weeds from (a farmland).
example_en: The farmer removed the weeds from the field with the weeding implement.

definition: the act of turning something into a coil; a forming of a circle.
example_en: He learned the coiling of the rope.

definition: any of the the notched extremities of a bow.
example_en: The archer tied the string to the notched end of the bow.

definition: a good job or profession.
example_en: He obtained a good job and became happy.

definition: a man who eats to excess or who takes pleasure in immoderate eating; a glutton.
example: ಕೂಳ್ಬಣಿಗನಾದ ಅವನು ಊಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ತಿಂದನು.
example_en: Being a glutton, he ate more than everyone else at the meal.

definition: (masc.) a native of Bengal, a state in eastern India.
example_en: That native of Bengal came from Calcutta to Mysore.

definition: to lose belief in one's own abilities, confidence, etc.; to become diffident.
example: ಸೋಲಿನ ನಂತರ ಅವನು ಗಬ್ಬವಿಕ್ಕಿ ಮಾತನಾಡಲು ಹಿಂಜರಿದನು.
example_en: After the defeat he became diffident and hesitated to speak.

definition: an area surrounded on its four sides by buildings; a quadrangle.
example_en: The children are playing in the quadrangle.

definition: (said of plants) the state of being under grown; undergrowth.
example_en: Because there was no rain, undergrowth is seen among the crops.

definition: the tree Prunus armeniaca ( = Armeniaca vulgaris) of Rosaceae family.
example_en: The apricot tree bears sweet fruits.

definition: a preparation of rice with pulse or pulses.
example_en: They served rice-and-pulse khichdi for breakfast.

definition: thick; fat; corpulent.
example_en: That ox had grown thick and fat.

definition: to mount a horse.
example_en: He mounts a horse every morning.

definition: (a wound) to get healed.
example_en: His wound got healed within a few days.

definition: preventing, having the tendency to prevent, misfortune from happening.
example: ಆ ಗಿಡಮೂಲಿಕೆ ಅರಿಷ್ಟನಿವಾರಕ ಗುಣ ಹೊಂದಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: They say that herb has a property that prevents misfortune.

definition: to be overtaken by; to remain in or to go back to a lower or previous stage or position.
example: ಅವನು ಓಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಮತ್ತೆ ಪಿಂಚಿ ಕೊನೆಗೆ ಬಂದನು.
example_en: He fell behind again in the race and came last.

definition: to move rapidly; to run; to rush.
example_en: When the fire broke out, everyone rushed outside.

definition: to putforth new leaves.
example_en: As the rainy season arrived, the plants began to put forth new leaves.

definition: Sītā, the daughter of the Earth-mother.
example_en: Ravana abducted Sita, the daughter of the Earth-mother.

definition: a large mound.
example: ಹೊಲದ ನಡುವೆ ಒಂದು ಹೆದ್ದೆವರು ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A large mound stood out in the middle of the field.

definition: that which has flowered (said of plants).
example: ಮಳೆಯ ನಂತರ ಪುಷ್ಪಿತ ಮರಗಳು ತೋಟಕ್ಕೆ ಶೋಭೆ ತಂದವು.
example_en: After the rain, the flowering trees brought beauty to the garden.

definition: to come out; to be given forth, discharged.
example_en: Water came out and flowed from the well.

definition: a raised patch of skin, specif. of epidermis, filled with watery matter and caused by a burn, frost-bite, rubbing, etc.; a blister.
example: ಬಿಸಿ ಪಾತ್ರೆ ಮುಟ್ಟಿ ಬೆರಳಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಪ್ಪಳೆ ಎದ್ದಿತು.
example_en: By touching the hot vessel, a blister rose on the finger.

definition: a small cup like vessel with a handle.
example_en: She drank water from the small handled cup.

definition: another's wife.
example_en: One should not think evil about another's wife.

definition: a division of an army, consisting of elephants; a troop of elephants.
example_en: There was a large troop of elephants in the king's army.

definition: to lean on.
example_en: The child slept leaning against its mother's body.

definition: worthy of being lauded; praiseworthy; commendable; laudable.
example_en: Her service is commendable.

definition: one who sells, nuts, berries, fruits, etc.
example_en: That fruit-seller was selling fruits in the market.

definition: the quality or fact of being thick.
example_en: I was surprised to see the thickness of this cloth.

definition: the indigo plant Indigo tinctoria of Papilionaceae family; common indigo.
example_en: The farmers had grown the common indigo plant in the field.

definition: a head harness, consisting of a headstall, bit and reins, for controlling a horse; a bridle.
example: ಕುದುರೆಯ ತಲೆಗೆ ದುಕ್ಕಡಿ ಕಟ್ಟಿ ಸವಾರಿ ಆರಂಭಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He fastened the bridle on the horse's head and began the ride.

definition: the chief of an army.
example_en: The army chief led the troops into battle.

definition: the basil plant Ocimum basilicum of Lamiaceae family; sweet basil.
example_en: Sweet basil seeds are sold in the seed shop.

definition: one who cannot, does not have the tendency to, enjoy the poetical, musical or aesthetic sentiments.
example_en: That unappreciative man did not enjoy even after listening to music.

definition: to make another weak or weaker; to make meek.
example_en: The continuous illness made him weak.

definition: a parabolic circle.
example_en: In the mathematics lesson, they drew a parabolic circle.

definition: one who makes pottery; a potter.
example_en: That potter used to make clay pots.

definition: a heavy rain.
example: ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಕಡೆಯಿಂದ ಮರಮಳೆ ಬಂದು ಬೆಳೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಹಾನಿಯಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Heavy rain came from the hills and damaged the crops.

definition: to march against.
example_en: The army marched against the enemies.

definition: a trying to get cheaply a thing being bought esp. arguing about the price for a meagre benefit.
example_en: She haggled over the price of vegetables in the market.

definition: an acquired habit.
example_en: Morning walking had become his acquired habit.

definition: the governmental authority to get coins minted in one's name.
example_en: Only the king had the authority to get coins minted in his name.

definition: a sweet, crystalline substance, obtained chiefly from the juice of the sugarcane and the sugar beet, used extensively for sweetening foods and beverages; sugar.
example_en: They prepared sweets using sugar.

definition: the quality, condition, duty of a) an ambassador, b) a messenger, c) a mediator or d) a servant.
example_en: His duty as a mediator resolved the conflict.

definition: spherically.
example_en: That ball was shaped spherically.

definition: a hard, tough metal, malleable under certain conditions, composed of iron alloyed with small percentages of carbon and often variously with other metals, as nickel, chromium, manganese, etc., to produce hardness, resistance to rusting, etc.; steel.
example_en: This bridge is built with strong steel.

definition: that which is very tall; a skyscraper.
example_en: The whole town can be seen from the skyscraper.

definition: a seasoning of food with oil, spices, asafoetida, etc.
example: ಅಮ್ಮ ಸಾರಿಗೆ ಪೊಡ್ಡವಣೆ ಮಾಡಿ ರುಚಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: Mother seasoned the curry and made it tastier.
